locations.note: The Runner: an ANZAC messenger in the Gallipoli landings. The Turning Tides maps Cape Helles and Achi Baba cover the same peninsula.
Avanti Savoia: Italian Arditi storm the Austro-Hungarian forts on the cliffs of Monte Grappa. Also a multiplayer map.
Through Mud and Blood: the Mark V tank Black Bess fights up the road to Cambrai in the autumn of 1918. The Giant's Shadow multiplayer map lies on the same ground.
Amiens: street fighting through the city in 1918, a multiplayer map.
Storm of Steel: the prologue, the Harlem Hellfighters holding a shattered village against the German offensive of the Second Battle of the Marne in 1918.
Sinai Desert: the dunes and railway of the Sinai campaign, a multiplayer map.
Fao Fortress: the British landing at the Ottoman fort at the mouth of the Shatt al-Arab, a multiplayer map.
St Quentin Scar: a shell-torn village near Saint-Quentin, a multiplayer map.
Friends in High Places ends with Blackburn over London, fighting a zeppelin raid on the city.
Nothing Is Written: Bedouin rebel Zara Ghufran hunts the Ottoman armoured train across the Arabian desert with Lawrence of Arabia, raiding the Hejaz railway.
Suez: a multiplayer map on the banks of the canal, the Ottoman attack of 1915.
Argonne Forest: trench lines through the shattered woods, a multiplayer map.
They Shall Not Pass: the Verdun Heights map, the burning hillsides of the 1916 battle.
Fort de Vaux: fighting through the tunnels of the fort, a They Shall Not Pass map.
Soissons and Rupture: the French counter-attack of 1918 across the Aisne country, two They Shall Not Pass maps.
Nivelle Nights: a night battle at the fort of La Malmaison on the Chemin des Dames.
Prise de Tahure: night fighting in the ruined village after the Nivelle Offensive.
Łupków Pass: a winter battle in the Carpathians, an In the Name of the Tsar map.
Galicia and Brusilov Keep: the Russian Brusilov offensive of 1916 across the Galician plain and a Carpathian fortress, two In the Name of the Tsar maps.
Albion: the German landing on the island in October 1917, an In the Name of the Tsar map.
Tsaritsyn and Volga River: the Russian Civil War maps, Red Army against White Guard in the city and on the frozen river.
Zeebrugge: the British raid on the mole and the canal, a Turning Tides map.
Heligoland Bight: a naval battle around the red cliffs, a Turning Tides map.
Caporetto: the Austro-German breakthrough in the Soča valley, an Apocalypse map.
Passchendaele: the mud of the Third Battle of Ypres, an Apocalypse map.
River Somme: the 1916 battlefield, an Apocalypse map.
